**Supplier Obligations:**
* Any change in the scope of service must be made in writing and signed by both parties (L95, L105, L115, L125, L135).
* Supplier's technician shall arrive at the warehouse in Ashdod within 4 hours for an urgent call, and within 2 days for a regular call (L96, L106, L116, L126, L136).
* Both parties shall keep secret any information received within the framework of the engagement (L98, L128, L138).
* The supplier shall coordinate in advance with the site manager any work at the Kiryat Gat plant that requires a shutdown (L99, L107, L117, L119, L139).
* The supplier shall appoint one client manager to coordinate communication with the client (L101, L111, L121, L131).
* The supplier shall maintain an available spare parts inventory to service the Kiryat Gat plant (L104, L114).
* The supplier shall insure its employees with employers' liability insurance and third-party insurance (L107, L115, L127, L137).
* The supplier shall perform a monthly maintenance visit at the logistics center in Holon and submit a report on the visit (L112, L122, L132).

**Client Obligations:**
* The client is entitled to inspect the quality of service at any time, with prior coordination (L100, L110, L120, L130).
* The client shall pay the consideration within 45 days from receipt of a lawful tax invoice (L103, L123, L133).

**Fines:**
* Use of non-original spare parts at the Kiryat Gat plant: 6,750 NIS per case (L97).
* Breach of safety instructions on site at the Haifa branch: 8,500 NIS per case (L102).
* Loss of client equipment at the Ashdod warehouse: 10,250 NIS per case (L108).
* Failure to perform preventive maintenance on time at the Holon logistics center: 12,000 NIS per case (L113).
* Working without a valid entry permit at the Tel Aviv offices: 13,750 NIS per case (L118).
* Failure to document a service call in the system at the Kiryat Gat plant: 15,500 NIS per case (L124).
* Leaving waste on site after work at the Haifa branch: 17,250 NIS per case (L129).
* Delay in responding to an urgent service call at the Ashdod warehouse: 19,000 NIS per case (L134).
